name: Viktor Popov
tagline: 🎮 Senior Unity Developer with 5+ years of commercial experience.
bio:
🚀 I’ve contributed to 9 mobile releases that reached 4.5M+ downloads in total.
🛠️ I’ve delivered under tight deadlines, optimized games for very low-end devices, 
and on my latest project, I led a team of 3 and ported a mobile title to the web. 

✨ Games are my passion, and building them is how I express myself. 
I love the feeling when a system just works - clean, smooth to use, and built to last. 
I love the feeling when a real player enjoys the game because it’s fun and interesting. 
That’s what I’m always ready to work hard for.
